import re
from datetime import datetime


def parse_nginx_log_line(line: str) -> dict:
    """
    Parse an nginx access log line into a dictionary.

    Expected format (combined log format):
    <ip> - - [<timestamp>] "<method> <url> <protocol>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<user_agent>"

    Example:
    127.0.0.1 - - [10/Oct/2023:13:55:36 +0000] "GET /index.html HTTP/1.1" 200 1234 "-" "Mozilla/5.0"
    """
    pattern = re.compile(
        r'^(?P<ip>\S+) - - \[(?P<timestamp>[^\]]+)\] '
        r'"(?P<method>\S+) (?P<url>[^\"]*) (?P<protocol>[^\"]*)" '
        r'(?P<status>\d+) (?P<bytes>\d+) '
        r'"(?P<referer>[^\"]*)" "(?P<user_agent>[^\"]*)"'
    )

    match = pattern.match(line.strip())
    if not match:
        raise ValueError(f"Could not parse log line: {line}")

    result = match.groupdict()

    # Convert status and bytes to integers
    result["status"] = int(result["status"])
    result["bytes"] = int(result["bytes"])

    # Parse timestamp into a datetime object
    result["timestamp"] = datetime.strptime(result["timestamp"], "%d/%b/%Y:%H:%M:%S %z")

    return result
